verdict.rationale: The pack has no documentation of inviting an external accountant or bookkeeper as a user, and nothing on role-based or scoped permissions. The nearest items are adjacent: an accountant-facing page about migrating clients' data, multi-company management under one login, and AI that gathers 'what your accountant needs'. None of these shows a founder granting role-scoped access to review and adjust the books.

support.subject: As a founder, I can invite my external accountant or bookkeeper with role-scoped access to review and adjust the books
